title: Add the recipe data model and API
body:
## Spec
Add a deterministic recipe collection and recipe-specific API alongside the existing application so frontend work can consume a stable contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `/api/recipes` returns at least 12 complete recipes
- [ ] Search includes ingredients and dietary tags
- [ ] Cookbook add, list, and remove behavior works
- [ ] Rails return recipe IDs

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Create the TableStory design system
body:
## Spec
Create reusable TableStory brand tokens and responsive recipe-card styling using the approved warm kitchen palette.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All five approved brand colors are defined
- [ ] Recipe cards and artwork have responsive styles
- [ ] Focus and saved states do not rely only on color

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Build the mobile TableStory experience
body:
## Spec
Replace the mobile cinema interface with TableStory browse, search, recipe detail, ingredients, steps, and My Cookbook interactions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Home clearly displays the TableStory identity and tagline
- [ ] Search matches recipe and ingredient content
- [ ] Recipe details show metadata, ingredients, and ordered steps
- [ ] My Cookbook controls expose saved state

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #1, #2

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Add the television recipe experience
body:
## Spec
Add TV recipe rails, ten-foot layouts, and keyboard/remote browse and detail navigation while retaining the mobile experience.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `?mode=tv` renders the TV layout
- [ ] Four named recipe rails use `/api/rails`
- [ ] Arrow keys and Enter operate browse cards
- [ ] Escape and Backspace return from recipe detail

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #3

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Complete documentation and terminology verification
body:
## Spec
Document TableStory startup and verification, remove obsolete film data, and add an automated partial-rebrand terminology check.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] README documents mobile and TV startup
- [ ] Obsolete film catalog is removed
- [ ] Automated checks reject customer-facing cinema terminology
- [ ] All Python and JavaScript tests pass

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #4

agent: mock
